definitions.explanation: A small organ of the lymphatic system. Strictly the correct medical term is {リンパ節|せつ} (lymph node), but リンパ{腺|せん} remains the everyday word people use, especially when describing swelling during illness.

examples.japanese: リンパ{腺|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れている→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧。

examples.english: When I catch a cold, the lymph nodes in my neck start to hurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧や⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リンパ{腺|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}って→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor carefully felt and examined the lymph nodes in my neck and armpits.

notes:
The common, everyday word for a lymph node, written with katakana ⟦リンパ→リンパ：06009_rinpa⟧ (from Latin/Dutch) plus ⟦{腺|せん}→腺：17997_sen⟧ (gland). Most often heard in connection with swelling during illness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リンパ{腺|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れる→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧: the lymph nodes swell
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リンパ{腺|せん}: the lymph nodes in the neck

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {リンパ節|せつ}: lymph node — the technically correct medical term used in clinical writing
- ⟦リンパ→リンパ：06009_rinpa⟧⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧: lymph (the fluid itself)
